newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish CD market to operate from Friday.
newsitem.headline: Turkish CD market to operate from Friday.

text.p: A market in certificates of deposit will begin operations at the Istanbul stock exchange from July 25, the bourse said in a statement.
Trading in the instruments will be between 11 a.m. and 5 p.m. (0800-1400 GMT), the statement said.
It said the bourse's management board had accepted an application to enter the market of CDs from Kazakhstan's JSC Kazkommertsbank, issued by The Bank of New York.
